_about: Rates for the solar (prosumer) outlook. All are SECONDARY sources (press / explainer sites quoting NEPRA); none is read from a NEPRA determination yet. The outlook says so, and shows a range for the energy purchase price.

napp.what: national average power purchase price - paid for exported surplus under agreements signed before the Prosumer Regulations 2026 (reg. 21(2)), until they expire
napp.source: Express Tribune, 9 Feb 2026 ('current rate Rs25.9 per unit'); Business Recorder 13 Mar 2025 cites Rs 27 (NAPP-based) a year earlier

epp.what: national average energy purchase price - paid for ALL exported units under net billing (reg. 14), which applies at renewal (reg. 21(2))
epp.source: Express Tribune, 9 Feb 2026 ('Rs11 per unit'); Dawn Prism ('Rs9-Rs11 per kwh')
